items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: You know, Mr. Passage, he was playing at the

ctx.x: Well, the only band I see Bichet was playing with Bollipetite. They was playing at the cabaret and I used to pass there some nights. You know, Mr. Passage, he was playing at the, I mean Bollipetite had about five pieces. Murray and, Murray and, Ben. See, but in other words they had bands all on Bayesian streets too, you know. Yeah, they had bands all on Bayesian streets. Every colony had a cabaret, then they had bands all around. At 25, band 25 and 28. Band on both sides of the street.
Who would be at 25 and 28? Juar was playing there.
